description: This file defines the main controller class 'TodoCtrl' for a Todo application, managing todo items, user interactions, and scope bindings in an AngularJS project.

classes.name: todos.TodoCtrl
classes.description: Main controller for the Todo app, handling todo list operations, scope interactions, and dependency injections.

methods.name: onPath
methods.description: Sets the status filter based on the current URL path.

methods.name: onTodos
methods.description: Updates remaining and done counts, and persists todos.

methods.name: addTodo
methods.description: Adds a new todo item to the list.

methods.name: editTodo
methods.description: Begins editing a specified todo item.

methods.name: revertEdits
methods.description: Reverts changes to a todo item.

methods.name: doneEditing
methods.description: Completes editing of a todo item, saving or removing it.

methods.name: markAll
methods.description: Marks all todos as completed or active.
